title: Instruction phases for a doubling move
statement: Let $E$ be a natural number, let $s$ and $d$ be registers among 18 registers, let $x$ be an exit label, let $m$ assign a label to each of four phases, and let $j$ be one of those phases. At phase $0$, test whether $s$ is zero, branching to $x$ if so and to phase $1$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement $s$ and continue to phase $2$; at phase $2$, increment $d$ and continue to phase $3$; and at phase $3$, increment $d$ and return to phase $0$.
